verified_context: User wants a Then primitive with a card top-right menu button, Archive entry and confirmation before mutation.
Existing actions op,op lowers to protected operation forms and rejects suites. Generic menu currently renders route links only. dropdown uses focus-within wrappers and has no source lowering.

Prompted views receive opaque HTML bindings for declared controls. Their parser currently allows actions but no groups. Canonical delete owns permissions, CSRF, version and confirmation; its current rendering is a large inline confirmation card.

alternatives.A: Extend actions with a nonempty suite of canonical controls. A suite defaults to overflow menu presentation, while the existing operation-list form keeps its behavior. Add shared compact entries and confirmation presentation without new invocation logic.
alternatives.B: Introduce action_menu as a distinct Then grouping for canonical controls, with default overflow placement, shared entries and confirmation. Keep actions unchanged; add a new catalog word.
alternatives.C: Implement generic dropdown trigger/content source slots and use them explicitly with canonical controls; add shared compact entries and confirmation but author the trigger and positioning in each app.

design.instructions: Choose the smallest complete source design for a shared overflow action menu, balancing concise authoring, existing meaning, and implementation clarity.
